matrix.test: Precisely edit T to G and G to T in an isogenic HCT 116 model, then measure CTCF occupancy and PYDC2 and CCDC50 expression

G increases CTCF occupancy and produces a reproducible PYDC2 regulatory change.
T increases CTCF occupancy and produces a reproducible CCDC50 regulatory change.

next_experiment: Run the low-cost matched-allele CTCF binding assay first. It tests the unsupported direction in H1 against the null and can also distinguish H1 from H2; a positive result would still need endogenous occupancy and regulatory validation.
